title: Second controller assigned to wrong default site after adding a new site
description: When creating a new site and adding multiple controllers, the second controller is incorrectly assigned to the default site instead of the newly created one.
steps: Login to the Luxor Cloud application.
Observe the site assignment for the second controller.
actual: The second controller is assigned to the default site instead of the newly created site.
expected: The second controller should be assigned to the newly created site.
